# Division (IEEE 754-2008 clause 5.4.1 and 7.3). The preferred exponent is
# Q(x) - Q(y); a finite x divided by an infinity is a zero at MinExp. A
# quotient of two Precision-digit coefficients is never within one unit
# of the last place below a power of ten unless it is exact, so division
# has no carry class (see README).

# --- Div64 ---

Div64 even exact 1 4 -> 0.25
Div64 even exact 8.00 2 -> 4.00
Div64 even exact 2.400 2.0 -> 1.20
Div64 even exact 1000 100 -> 10
Div64 even exact 1000 1 -> 1000
Div64 even exact 2.40E+6 2 -> 1.20E+6
Div64 even exact 12 12 -> 1
Div64 even exact 1 8 -> 0.125
Div64 even exact -6 3 -> -2

Div64 up exact 1 4 -> 0.25
Div64 even exact 1 0.001 -> 1E+3
Div64 even exact 1.000 0.001 -> 1000
